scientific_intent.scientific_task: Evaluate a matrix-vector product whose weights are compressed into learned signed bit planes with per-group scales and optional offsets.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: y[m]=sum_k x[k]*(bias[group(k),m]+sum_b alpha[group(k),b,m]*sign(W[k,b,m])). Bit sign is +1 for set bits and -1 for unset bits. Alpha is learned per group, bit plane and output; it is not a fixed power-of-two integer quantizer.
scientific_intent.discretization: Seven legal even-output configurations: M34/514/2050,K64/128/256,8/4/3 planes, group sizes32/64/128, bias and no-bias, plus zero-input control. Source Ktile32 with bias,64 without bias, M_tile2048 and256threads retained.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Every output and actual input/guard value exact against independent dense integer weighted matvec. Dense quarter-integer inputs and half scales ±1/128 give all intermediate values exactly representable in half: absolute integer coefficient bound <=2048 on1/512 lattice. All32 packed bit positions active except explicit zero control.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: One input vector, moderate output tails across one/two M tiles, one-to-eight K tiles, multiple quantization groups. Not full source large-shape CLI or batched general GEMM.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: True FP16 lookup sums, scaled accumulation and packed half2 atomics. Native selected SASS contains contracted HFMA2 despite separate PTX mul/add. Exact dyadic class makes contraction and atomic scheduling irrelevant here; arbitrary FP16 rounding and neural-model accuracy are outside certification.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Source NAVER LUT-GEMM compressed-weight inference operator, useful to study learned bit-plane lookup GEMV mapping. No end-to-end model quality, quantization calibration or production inference recommendation.
scientific_intent.description: Historical Julia source is dense Float32 matvec without packed planes, learned scales, offsets or LUT. Preserve it and restore actual source operator and shared lookup/packed atomic mapping in all Julia versions.
scientific_intent.provenance: Original source mv_fp16.h and kernels.cu, NAVER Cloud copyright2024 Apache2.0. Source headers and full originals archived. Independent oracle expands every packed bit directly; no LUT source reuse.
